description:
Examples in the release's manifest (examples/manifest.json at its tag).
features = comma-separated tags ("effects,records"); empty = no filter.
status = "working" | "broken" | "aspirational" | "" ("passing" = working,
"failing" = the other two); empty = working only. At most 50 are returned;
total says how many matched.

title: List examples
